# Usage of PrimeKG Reasoning

## Dataset Creation

For detail of dataset creation, please refer to [Dataset_Creation_README](./build_dataset/README.md)

## Usage

```
python train.py --mode finetune --datasets data/PrimeKG --gpu 0 --model_path  ./saved_models/latest_model.pt
```

* For GraphOracle+, just use the embedding of data generated by multi Foundation Model, which can be found in ./unimodal, or you can download and use their embedding directly in this [github repo](https://github.com/RyanWangZf/BioBridge/tree/main/data).
